title: minuartia howellii
intro: Minuartia howellii, commonly known as Howell's catchfly, is a flowering plant species native to the western United States. It is a member of the pink family (Caryophyllaceae) and is known for its pink or white, five-petaled flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as wound healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia howellii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
